shots.text: The Stoneborn carve their cities into the canyon walls, and they carve the faces of their kings above the doors, so the kings can watch the road forever.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Red rock canyon, cliff cities in terraces, giant stone faces of old kings.

shots.text: The Sky came down the canyon in armour, and the kings watched that, too.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Storm spirits in armour pouring down the walls. Above them, on a thunderbird of black cloud, an old warchief with a crown of lightning: Vholt.
